Typhoon Bavi Approaches China, Taiwan, and Japan After Evacuations

Typhoon Bavi has prompted large-scale evacuations in China, with over 1.7 million people moved from high-risk areas in Zhejiang province. The storm is also affecting Taiwan and Japan's southwestern islands, causing injuries, power outages, and flight cancellations. Authorities have issued high emergency alerts as the typhoon brings strong winds and heavy rain.
